cards.question: Under partition, what does CAP force you to choose?
cards.answer: Availability OR Consistency (P is unavoidable in distributed systems).

cards.question: What does PACELC add beyond CAP?
cards.answer: When no partition: trade Latency vs Consistency.

cards.question: Kadane's one-line recurrence?
cards.answer: cur = max(nums[i], cur + nums[i]) — start fresh or extend.

cards.question: Why BFS for unweighted shortest path?
cards.answer: First time you reach a node is minimum edge count.

cards.question: Why does Dijkstra fail with negative edges?
cards.answer: Greedy extract-min assumes non-negative — negative edge can create shorter path later.

cards.question: Why iterate capacity backwards in 0/1 knapsack?
cards.answer: So each item is used at most once in the inner loop.

cards.question: Give a classic Liskov violation.
cards.answer: Square extends Rectangle — setWidth breaks area invariant.

cards.question: Decorator vs Adapter in one line?
cards.answer: Decorator stacks behavior (same interface); Adapter translates incompatible interface.

cards.question: How prevent double-booking in BookMyShow?
cards.answer: Seat hold with TTL + conditional confirm OR row lock OR optimistic version.

cards.question: At-least-once delivery requires what from consumers?
Celebrity fanout problem — push or pull?
cards.answer: Pull or hybrid — push doesn't scale for millions of followers.

cards.question: What problem do fencing tokens solve?
cards.answer: Stale lock holder writing after TTL expired and new holder acquired lock.

cards.question: Why doesn't @Transactional work on self-invocation?
cards.answer: Spring AOP proxy is bypassed on internal calls within same class.

cards.question: AWS service for decoupling producer from consumer spikes?
cards.answer: SQS (buffer); SNS for fan-out; EventBridge for routing.
